sentence: This project looks at how molecular imaging and other imaging methods can help detect cardiovascular disease early and prevent it.
This project brings together imaging, image analysis, cancer biology, and immunology to solve problems in cancer treatment.
This project tests a virtual reality kitchen test that measures everyday function in older adults.
This project compares insulin with metformin for treating diabetes in pregnancy and checks how each affects infant growth and metabolism.
This project uses existing data and machine learning to find out how a reactive central nervous system may cause pain sensitivity in painful urinary conditions.
This project studies extracellular vesicles from blood to learn what they show about normal and disease processes in the brain.
This project tests raw meat and seafood from stores for antibiotic-resistant bacteria to monitor resistance in the food supply.
This project studies how an epigenetic pathway helps aggressive neuroendocrine prostate cancer form and avoid the immune system.
This project tries to find out which molecules and cell processes control how the uterus forms in mammals.
This project uses machine learning to predict disease severity and long-term effects after infection with Lassa virus, Ebola virus or COVID-19.
This project studies how soluble adenylate cyclase is controlled in mammalian sperm to understand how sperm gain fertilizing ability.
This project supports multidisciplinary research on the biology, treatment and prevention of HIV and AIDS.
This project studies how stress changes brain circuits and why this may lead to different cardiovascular risk in males and females.
This project builds genetic tools and mutant strains to study how Akkermansia and Bacteroides bacteria degrade mucins in the intestine.
This project tests whether targeting a histone demethylase eases synaptic defects in mouse models of autism and in human neurons grown from stem cells.
This project studies whether retrotransposons, called selfish DNA, in aging cells and brain tissue drive Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project studies how the environmental toxicant 1,4-dioxane causes cancer through a transcription factor that promotes extracellular vesicle formation.
This project studies how brainstem neurons that express norepinephrine connect to the hypothalamus and help control reproduction under stress.
This project brings scientists and clinicians together to discuss stem cell biology, myeloid cells and leukemia.
This project studies how a gene found at high levels in liver cancer helps the cancer develop and whether targeting it could work as treatment.
